beats.en: The world map shows five oceans: the Pacific, the Atlantic, the Indian, the Arctic and the Southern or Antarctic Ocean. The lines that divide them are only conventions.

textbookBox.concept: White shapes in the picture of the Earth are clouds. They bring rain to the continents. The monsoon rains that India expects each summer begin over the ocean, and without them our farming and all

beats.en: White shapes in the picture of the Earth are clouds. They bring rain to the continents. The monsoon rains that India expects each summer begin over the ocean, and without them our farming and all life would suffer.
beats.speakEn: White shapes in the picture of the Earth are clouds. They bring rain to the continents. The monsoon rains that India expects each summer begin over the ocean, and without them our farming and all life would suffer.

beats.en: How many continents are there? The answer depends on how we count. We can count anywhere from four to seven. North America and South America are usually two continents, but they can be seen as one landmass.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 social-science · Oceans and Continents · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: The continents do not include all the land. Smaller pieces of land surrounded by water on all sides are called islands.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Oceans and Continents: The continents do not include all the land. Smaller pieces of land surrounded by water on all sides are called islands. Continents are also surrounded by water, but they are too large to be called islands.
